query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_published,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mediaType = 'movie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as movies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mediaType = 'series' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as series
FROM mcu_media 
WHERE status = 'published' AND content IS NOT NULL;

SELECT slug, title FROM mcu_media WHERE status != 'published' OR content IS NULL ORDER BY releaseOrder
